### Clases definidas:

#### Clase `Android` (Línea 14)
- **Docstring:** _Follows the guidance `from here <https://android.stackexchange.com/a/216132>`_.

Makes use of the `appname <platformdirs.api.PlatformDirsABC.appname>`, `version
<platformdirs.api.PlatformDirsABC.version>`, `ensure_exists <platformdirs.api.PlatformDirsABC.ensure_exists>`._
- **Métodos:**
  - `def user_data_dir(self)` (Línea 24): :return: data directory tied to the user, e.g. ``/data/user/<userid>/<packagename>/files/<AppName>``
  - `def site_data_dir(self)` (Línea 29): :return: data directory shared by users, same as `user_data_dir`
  - `def user_config_dir(self)` (Línea 34): :return: config directory tied to the user, e.g.         ``/data/user/<userid>/<packagename>/shared_prefs/<AppName>``
  - `def site_config_dir(self)` (Línea 42): :return: config directory shared by the users, same as `user_config_dir`
  - `def user_cache_dir(self)` (Línea 47): :return: cache directory tied to the user, e.g.,``/data/user/<userid>/<packagename>/cache/<AppName>``
  - `def site_cache_dir(self)` (Línea 52): :return: cache directory shared by users, same as `user_cache_dir`
  - `def user_state_dir(self)` (Línea 57): :return: state directory tied to the user, same as `user_data_dir`
  - `def user_log_dir(self)` (Línea 62): :return: log directory tied to the user, same as `user_cache_dir` if not opinionated else ``log`` in it,
  e.g. ``/data/user/<userid>/<packagename>/cache/<AppName>/log``
  - `def user_documents_dir(self)` (Línea 73): :return: documents directory tied to the user e.g. ``/storage/emulated/0/Documents``
  - `def user_downloads_dir(self)` (Línea 78): :return: downloads directory tied to the user e.g. ``/storage/emulated/0/Downloads``
  - `def user_pictures_dir(self)` (Línea 83): :return: pictures directory tied to the user e.g. ``/storage/emulated/0/Pictures``
  - `def user_videos_dir(self)` (Línea 88): :return: videos directory tied to the user e.g. ``/storage/emulated/0/DCIM/Camera``
  - `def user_music_dir(self)` (Línea 93): :return: music directory tied to the user e.g. ``/storage/emulated/0/Music``
  - `def user_desktop_dir(self)` (Línea 98): :return: desktop directory tied to the user e.g. ``/storage/emulated/0/Desktop``
  - `def user_runtime_dir(self)` (Línea 103): :return: runtime directory tied to the user, same as `user_cache_dir` if not opinionated else ``tmp`` in it,
  e.g. ``/data/user/<userid>/<packagename>/cache/<AppName>/tmp``
  - `def site_runtime_dir(self)` (Línea 114): :return: runtime directory shared by users, same as `user_runtime_dir`
